newsitem.title: USA: Griffon Corp announces joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Griffon Corp announces joint venture.

text.p: Griffon Corp announced today that its Cleveland-based specialty plastic films business, Clopay Plastic Products Co, has formed a joint venture with Corovin GmbH, a manufacturer of nonwovens headquartered in Peine, Germany.

The joint venture will be called Finotech Verbundstoffe GmbH, said the company in a release dated November 6. The joint company will develop and market polymeric films and nonwovens for the European, South African and Middle East markets.
Griffon said that Finnotech will begin production in the first half of 1997.
